title: TEI: Target-Evaluate-Improve - A Cost-Efficient Self-Improving Loop for Agentic Systems via Sequential Decision Gating (TEI-SWE)
description: Artifacts for TEI-SWE: the frozen TEI-SWE-30 SWE-bench agent set, 1,140 candidate why-records, blinded A/B votes (pre-repair confirmatory 24/26 agents, 118/130 votes; post-repair adaptive retest 26/26 strict majorities, 24 unanimous, 128/130 votes), pre-registered sham-placebo arm, budget-matched random-proposal arm, supplementary cross-provider check, execution micro-arm, audits, and the complete pipeline.
